presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No background, no glasses, earrings or stubble.
presets.description: The style stripped back: no background, so the avatar sits on whatever your page is, and the three components that only show on a third of seeds switched off.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: One warm brown for skin, hair and shirt.
presets.description: A real sepia print, which means the skin tone goes with it. Every other preset here leaves skin to the seed; this one cannot, because a color photograph of a face is not sepia. Two of the eight mouths are painted pink rather than taking the mouth color group, so those drop out.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: Properly grey rather than grey hair on a colored face. Useful for a print stylesheet, a disabled state, or anywhere color would carry meaning it should not. Two of the eight mouths are painted pink rather than taking the mouth color group, so those drop out.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: Four steps of one indigo and nothing else.
presets.description: Background, skin, hair and shirt take the same hue at four lightnesses. The style requires each of them to differ from the others, so a duotone here is really a four-step tonal ladder. Two of the eight mouths are painted pink rather than taking the mouth color group, so those drop out.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty hair and shirts, skin left to the seed.
presets.description: The style shares one bright thirteen-color palette across hair, shirt, glasses and earrings. This swaps it for dusty tones, which stops a page of avatars looking like a paint box.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Hair and shirts at full saturation on near black.
presets.description: The other direction on the same lever: six colors past anything the style ships, on a dark background so they read as lit. Skin still comes from the seed.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: Five soft backgrounds, everything else untouched.
presets.description: Changes nothing about the people, only what they stand in front of. The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The loud counterpart to Pastel Wall. Strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page, and the only preset here that will fight with a colorful interface rather than sit inside it.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind, everything else untouched.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.summary: Near black behind, light hair and shirts.
presets.description: For dark interfaces. Hair and shirt drop to the pale end of the style's own palette so the silhouette does not disappear into the background.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.summary: Glasses, earrings and stubble turned up.
presets.description: Three components sit at 10 to 30 percent, so a small set of avatars rarely shows them. This raises all three, which is what you want when showing the style off rather than filling a user list.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in on the face, for small avatars.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. At the size a comment thread gives an avatar, the default framing spends most of it on shoulders, and cropping in buys the detail back.
